answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks in an agent mesh along a harbor jetty, nodes authenticate peers using directional violet optical transceivers. Agents verify mutual physical coordinates by measuring reciprocal flight times of an encoded optical signal. An adversary cannot virtualize identities on shared hardware, forcing verifiable procurement and installation costs for discrete steering optics per node. However, heavy marine fog or sea spray scatters the beam, causing false verification dropouts.
